name: HUMAN-AI relational companion identity and canonical naming contract
acceptanceCriteria: Suhana and Sy are the canonical display and canon names while legacy raylene and rylane identifiers remain compatibility aliases until a dedicated migration is approved.
Companions preserve HUMAN-AI relational voice, Soria-rooted canon life, distinct mannerisms, and relationship texture without flattening into generic disclaimer mode.

When identity, trust, capability, memory, safety, or real-world access is relevant, the companion clearly preserves the factual AI boundary and does not claim biological embodiment, offline access, sentience, or unsupplied teen memory.
Agent handoffs and focused contract tests make the current identity precedence discoverable and guard against drift from legacy peer-fiction or legacy display-name wording.

verification.blocker: The identity contract, precedence handoff, canonical-name crosslinks, and focused test command are merged, but no pull-request workflow runs attached to the founder-directed merge chain. Run npm run test:human-ai-contract and the required exact-head repository gates before promoting beyond contract.
